$comment: TIER 2 — semantic tokens. ADR-007 decision 2: this is the ONLY tier emitted
into the global sheet, and its names are the public, semver-stable contract.
Renaming one of these is a breaking change for every consumer.
Each colour entry names a primitive tone for the light scheme and one for
the dark scheme; the generator emits a single declaration using light-dark()
so a scheme flip costs one attribute rather than a re-declared token block.
`contrastWith` is not documentation. tools/verify-contrast.mjs reads it and
fails the build if the pair misses its WCAG 2.2 AA threshold in EITHER
scheme. Deleting a contrastWith entry to make the build pass removes the
guarantee, which is why the gate also asserts that every on-* token has one.

on-surface.$description: Body text on the default background.

surface-variant.$description: A recessed or grouped background: table headers, wells, disabled fields.

on-surface-variant.$description: Secondary text. Still body text, so still 4.5:1 — 'secondary' is not a licence to be unreadable.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a filled primary surface.

primary-container.$description: A tinted primary background: selected rows, soft badges.

outline.$description: A component boundary a user must be able to perceive: input borders, dividers that carry meaning. WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast, 3:1.

outline-variant.$description: A decorative separator carrying no information. Deliberately has NO contrastWith: holding a purely cosmetic hairline to 3:1 would force it to look like a border.

focus-ring.$description: The focus indicator. WCAG 2.4.11/2.4.13 — it must be perceivable against the background it sits on.

space.$comment: A 4px base step. Unitless multipliers would push arithmetic into every consumer; rem keeps it responsive to the user's font size.

$comment: ADR-007's governing rule: never let a variant axis become a selector.
Density is therefore ONE multiplier that components multiply their own
spacing by, not a set of density-specific rules. Changing it re-renders
no CSS and adds no bytes.
